owl-alpha_openrouter_free.tracking_note: Treat 10:00 AEST as the expected reset time, then measure real Owl Alpha usable capacity by recording exhaustion-to-exhaustion baselines.

cloud_capacity.tracking_rule: Use exhaustion baselines: record when a cloud model runs out, then compare with the next exhaustion point after reset to estimate usable capacity.
